excerpt: Its first phase, LEGEND-200, reuses the GERDA cryostat in Hall A of the Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso (LNGS) underground laboratory in Italy to house 200 kg of 76Ge-enriched high-purity germanium (HPGe) detectors.
publisher: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Nuclear Science Division
title: LEGEND-200 Enters Data Production Phase
